parameters.content:
## Notes

**Trigger contract** — this is a sub-workflow. The parent (webhook) workflow must accept the app's POST body `{ project_id, callback_url, requested_by }` (snake_case), generate a uuid, **respond synchronously** with `{ "job_id": "<uuid>" }` (the app returns 502 and never records the brief otherwise), then call this workflow with camelCase `{ jobId, projectId, callbackUrl, requestedBy }`.

**No `email_summary_jobs` writes** — that table is deprecated (`lib/db/sql/email_summary_jobs.sql`). The app stores briefs in `brief_conversations` and only learns the outcome from the HTTP callback.

**Callback auth** — all four callback POST nodes send `x-callback-secret: af39d4b6c6f8b5d6ea82f675bea81c49a857922c890b0a0524b12009193b1d23` as a literal header value. The app checks it in `app/api/project-brief/callback/route.ts`. Add the SAME value to the app's environment as `N8N_CALLBACK_SECRET` — until you do, the app skips the check and the header is simply ignored, so nothing breaks either way. If you ever change one side, change all five places (four nodes + the app env) or every brief hangs on 'processing'.

**Data gaps that are not fixable here**
- `users.project_folder_id` is set for Vivien only → everyone else returns `PM_FOLDER_NOT_CONFIGURED`.
- `projects.project_manager` includes `unknown`/`Unknown` (421 projects) and shared values (`Viktoria & Sonia`, `Viktoria und Vivien`, `Sonia und Vivien`, `Sonia & CH`) → `PM_NAME_UNKNOWN` / `PM_SHARED_ASSIGNMENT`.
- `Viktoria`, `Nesrin`, `Ani` have no `users` row (985 projects) → `PM_NOT_FOUND`.

**Graph auth** — no n8n credential is attached to any Graph node. `Get MS Access Token2` fetches one tenant-wide client-credentials token and every downstream call passes it as a `Bearer` header. The old OAuth2 credential caused `refreshToken is required`: it uses the authorization-code grant, which n8n will not run without a stored refresh token, and a client-credentials app never has one.

**Known limit** — messages are fetched in one page (`$top=999`); folders with more are truncated.

**Security** — the Azure client secret is stored inline in "Get MS Access Token2" as you asked. It was exposed in plaintext previously; rotate it in Azure and paste the new value here.

nodes.name: Get Project (Supabase)1
nodes.notes: Always Output Data is ON. Without it a missing project makes this node emit nothing, the IF below never fires, no callback is ever sent, and the UI polls 'processing' forever.

nodes.name: Resolve PM by First Name1
nodes.notes: FIXED: dropped `matchType: allFilters` and the second filter. That combination was not applying the filters, so returnAll returned every user and the next node reported PM_NAME_AMBIGUOUS for names that match exactly one row. role='pm' and deleted_at are now filtered in the code node, where the behaviour is explicit.

nodes.name: Prep Folder Search (Split)1
nodes.notes: FIXED: used $input.item, which is unavailable in 'Run Once for All Items' mode (the default) and throws. Now uses $input.first().

messages.content: =You are analyzing the full email thread for a real estate 3D-rendering project. The obvious project facts (client name, basic timeline, deliverables) are likely already tracked in the project management system. Your job is to surface what is NOT obvious or NOT already documented elsewhere. Prioritize: informal decisions made only over email, client preference changes, dissatisfaction or hesitation, scope creep or exceptions granted informally, casual commitments or deadlines, relationship/tone context, and unresolved open threads. Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown fences, no preamble) with exactly these keys: quick_facts (string), key_undocumented_context (string), open_questions (string), notable_moments (string, paraphrased not verbatim)

=Analyze this email thread and extract the non-obvious content.

{{ $json.thread_markdown }}

nodes.name: POST Error (PM Resolution Failed)1
nodes.notes: Carries whichever code the resolver produced: PM_NOT_FOUND, PM_NAME_AMBIGUOUS, PM_NAME_UNKNOWN, PM_SHARED_ASSIGNMENT or PM_FOLDER_NOT_CONFIGURED. The dashboard renders it as 'This brief failed (<code>)'.

nodes.name: Get MS Access Token2
nodes.notes: FIXED (refreshToken error): removed the 'Projectmanagement email credentials' OAuth2 credential. That credential uses the authorization-code grant, so n8n refuses to run without a stored refresh token - which a client-credentials app never has. A token request must not itself be OAuth-authenticated. Also switched multipart-form-data to form-urlencoded, which is what /oauth2/v2.0/token expects. The secret stays inline as you asked. One tenant-wide token reads any mailbox via /users/{email}/messages, because the app has Application-level Mail.Read consent. NOTE: rotate this secret in Azure - it was shared in plaintext.

nodes.name: Get Parent Folders2
nodes.notes: FIXED: the URL had a stray double-quote before the folder id (mailFolders/"{{...}}), which made every request malformed. Now reads root_folder_id straight off this node's input item instead of reaching back to Check PM Match Count1.

nodes.name: Get Parent Folders3
nodes.notes: FIXED: referenced $('Combine Token + Mailbox'), a node name that no longer exists (it is 'Combine Token + Mailbox1') - the expression would have thrown. Prep Folder Search already carries mailbox_email on every item, so it reads that instead.

nodes.name: Fetch All Messages
nodes.notes: FIXED: two broken references. The mailbox came from $('Combine Token + Mailbox'), a name that does not exist, and the Authorization header read $json.access_token - but this node's input is the folder-match code node, which carries no token, so it sent 'Bearer undefined'. Both now point at Combine Token + Mailbox1.

nodes.name: POST to Callback URL (Success)1
nodes.notes: FIXED: referenced $('Build Markdown'), which no longer exists (it is 'Build Markdown1') - every success callback would have thrown. Also: summary moved to the top level (the shape ai-brief-client.tsx prefers), and metadata.email_count / metadata.date_range / pm.mailbox_email are now sent. Build Markdown already computed those and they were being dropped, which is why the '<n> emails analyzed' line never rendered.
